title: Cut long text with …
summary: white-space: nowrap, overflow: hidden and text-overflow: ellipsis, together.
explanation: Single-line truncation needs three declarations, and each does one job: white-space: nowrap keeps the text on one line, overflow: hidden clips what does not fit, and text-overflow: ellipsis draws … at the cut.
The box needs a width limit for any of this to happen; here the list is 240px wide.
The full text is still in the HTML. A title attribute is a common way to let people see it on hover.
tryThis: Remove white-space: nowrap: the text wraps and there is nothing to cut.
Remove overflow: hidden: the text spills out and no ellipsis appears.
